issue.standard_remedy: Map the sub-tier and qualify an alternate
issue.summary: Depends on a single-source sub-tier supplier (Europe)

plan.diagnosis: Yukon Northern Chemicals AB (Sweden) represents USD 2,924,297 in annual spend with dependency on 17 sub-tier suppliers, including at least one single-source sub-tier creating supply chain vulnerability. Despite a moderate resiliency score of 60 and zero disruption events in the past 12 months, the single-source sub-tier configuration exposes USD 2.9M in spend to potential cascading failures from lower-tier supplier issues.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct sub-tier mapping workshop with Yukon Northern Chemicals AB to identify the critical single-source sub-tier supplier(s) among their 17 sub-tier partners and document material/component dependencies
Issue RFI to qualified European chemical suppliers to identify 2-3 alternate sub-tier sources capable of supplying the critical material/component, targeting suppliers in low-risk European regions
Require Yukon Northern Chemicals AB to qualify at least one alternate sub-tier supplier and provide dual-source commitment letter as contract amendment condition
Negotiate contractual language requiring sub-tier supply chain transparency and advance notification (90 days) of any sub-tier supplier changes for the USD 2.9M spend
Implement quarterly sub-tier supply chain reviews with Yukon Northern Chemicals AB and monitor resiliency score improvement from baseline of 60

plan.expected_impact: Mitigating single-source sub-tier risk will protect USD 2,924,297 in annual spend from supply disruption and improve supply chain resiliency score above the current 60 baseline.
kpis: Number of qualified alternate sub-tier suppliers (target: minimum 1 by Week 12)
Yukon Northern Chemicals resiliency score improvement (target: 60 to 75+ within 6 months)
Sub-tier supply chain visibility coverage (target: 100% for critical materials)
Sub-tier disruption events (target: maintain 0 events over next 12 months)
Percentage of USD 2.9M spend protected by dual sub-tier sourcing (target: 100%)
risks: Yukon Northern Chemicals AB may resist sub-tier transparency due to proprietary concerns or existing exclusive agreements with single-source sub-tier
Qualifying alternate sub-tier suppliers may require 6-12 month lead time for technical approvals, extending vulnerability window beyond initial 12-week timeline
Dual-sourcing at sub-tier level may increase Yukon's costs by 3-8%, potentially triggering price increase requests on the USD 2.9M spend
Limited availability of qualified chemical suppliers in Europe may constrain alternate sub-tier options, particularly for specialty materials
erp_actions: SAP: Add info record note (ME12) for Yukon Northern Chemicals AB flagging sub-tier dependency and requiring sub-tier documentation with each PO
SAP: Create source list entry (ME01) with validity dates for alternate supplier once qualified, enabling dual-source MRP runs
Coupa: Update supplier record with custom field 'Sub-Tier Risk Status' = 'Mitigation In Progress' and attach sub-tier mapping documentation
SAP: Implement release strategy for POs >USD 50,000 to Yukon (ME28) requiring Supply Chain Risk approval until alternate qualified
Oracle EBS: Add supplier attribute 'Requires Sub-Tier Disclosure' = 'Yes' and configure approval workflow for chemical category POs

All ERPs: Update vendor master records to include mandatory sub-tier supplier attachment field for this vendor across SAP (XK02), Oracle (Supplier entry), Dynamics 365 (Vendor record), and NetSuite (Vendor record)
